logo.rules: no recolour, no inversion, no shadow, no watermark, no distortion

color_rules.brand_green: identity, active nav, focus, selected — never large backgrounds
color_rules.brand_yellow: small accents only — never buttons or big surfaces
color_rules.gradient_brand: hero bars/module icons only — never forms, tables, buttons

form_field.style: label always above field, no floating placeholder

icons.functional: neutral at rest, green on hover/active

core_rules: One dominant action per screen region
AI outputs must show source/assumptions/confidence — never presented as fact
Any destructive or high-impact action needs preview + confirm + undo
No raw hex colors in code — use tokens above
